assets/vo/s01-fe008358.mp3: What's the difference between an LLM and an AI agent?
assets/vo/s02-7ed6ed29.mp3: An LLM, a large language model, reads your words and writes words back.
assets/vo/s02-0ff9cd2b.mp3: Ask it to book dinner, and you get advice. Then it stops.
assets/vo/s03-24dbb3e0.mp3: An AI agent wraps that same model in a system,
assets/vo/s03-9489ac8d.mp3: with tools it can use, memory, and a loop.
assets/vo/s04-70c3c745.mp3: It thinks, takes an action, checks the result, and loops until the job is done.
assets/vo/s05-eb579e1e.mp3: Same request, given to an agent.
assets/vo/s05-14ccbb4a.mp3: It remembers you love Italian, searches for open tables, and checks your calendar.
assets/vo/s05-9a3ad578.mp3: It asks before booking, then books it. Done.
assets/vo/s06-240d8e1a.mp3: So, an LLM answers questions. An agent completes tasks.
